A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same FourierSHAP work, with matching authors, methods, theoretical results, and datasets. Their main text, figures, tables, and appendices support reliable comparison despite renumbering and added material.

before.justification: Section 5 and Appendix F report original Fourier-approximation accuracy, SHAP accuracy, and runtime experiments on four datasets.

after.justification: Section 5 and Appendix E retain original experiments and add PLTreeSHAP comparisons, FastSHAP training times, and direct-formula SHAP validation.

M1.justification: The Fourier extraction stage, closed-form SHAP computation, four JAX implementations, and pruning procedures are retained. Appendix F discusses possible future extensions without changing the implemented method.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate Entacmaea, SGEMM, GB1, and avGFP with the same represented features and tasks. The corrected CatBoost panel label in Figure 1 does not indicate new coverage; continuous-feature and conditional-SHAP extensions remain future work.

E2.justification: Figure 3 adds PLTreeSHAP, labeled 'PLTreeSHAP (agg.)', to the retained TreeSHAP comparisons. The comparator set used in the black-box experiments remains unchanged.

E3.justification: New Figure 5 uses direct evaluation of the exponential SHAP formula as a reference for ten randomly selected Entacmaea queries and ten background points. Previously reported architectures, splits, pruning thresholds, and background/query-size grids remain unchanged.

E4.justification: Figure 5 adds a case-level check of KernelSHAP and FourierSHAP against directly computed SHAP values. This supplements v1's convergence-based reference validation, which is retained in v2.

E5.justification: Both versions describe sixteen background/query-size combinations for black-box error bars and standard deviations over five independent tree runs. No new seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance-testing procedures are specified.

E6.justification: Figure 3 revises tree-speedup curves, including shifting Entacmaea's FourierSHAP peak from depth 4 to 5, and adds PLTreeSHAP results showing it ahead at depths 6–8 on GB1 and avGFP. V2 also adds cross-dataset FastSHAP training times in Table 1 and direct-reference attribution results in Figure 5. Figure 2 and the GB1 convergence-table values remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Appendix B.2 supplies the factorial derivation of the binomial identity used in Equation 8 and explicitly justifies bounds in the counting argument, expanding v1's Appendix C.2. The propositions, lemma, theorem, and complexity guarantees remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The central two-stage computation, amortization, and speedup claims remain. V2 removes v1's assertion that the fine-grained accuracy–computation trade-off was previously unavailable in all black-box methods, narrowing the novelty claim.

C2.justification: Appendix F adds explanations of continuous-feature and conditional-SHAP extensions, including dimension growth and unresolved spectral assumptions. V2 also interprets the newly reported preparation costs and reverses v1's assignment of 'true to the model' versus 'true to the data' to the two SHAP variants.

D1.justification: Appendix E newly specifies the Xeon CPU, 20 GB RAM limit, and Slurm management, while Table 1 reports FastSHAP training times. These supplement existing RTX 4090 and implementation disclosures; they do not establish changes to the underlying settings.

R1.justification: V2 adds Zern et al. (2023) for PLTreeSHAP and Cao et al. (2019) for the continuous spectral-bias discussion. Existing related work is largely retained, while the sweeping trade-off novelty assertion is removed.

P1.justification: The title and abstract are shortened, several explanations are edited, and existing appendices B–F become A–E in the same order. A limitations/future-work appendix and NeurIPS checklist are appended; most existing narrative is retained.

P2.justification: V2 changes the document template, places Figures 1 and 2 together, corrects Figure 1's CatBoost dataset label, and extends Figure 3's display. It adds the training-time table and attribution heatmaps; the original convergence table is simply renumbered Table 2.

improvement.justification: The added tree comparator, preparation-cost reporting, direct-formula validation, and fuller proof make the efficiency and correctness evidence more informative. The applicability discussion also improves clarity. These gains are limited by missing PLTreeSHAP setup details in Appendix E.2 and Figure 5's claim of exact agreement despite small differences in its displayed values.
